result.summary: The main visual issue is the severely cropped and misaligned content at the bottom of the screen, indicating a layout rendering or overflow problem.

issues.description: The bottom section showing the pizza offer is severely clipped by the navigation bar or the edge of the screen, hiding crucial information and making the UI look broken.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the container padding or the scrollable area height to ensure all cards are fully visible above the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The '-100%' badge on the pizza image is partially overlapping the top edge of the card, suggesting a potential overflow or z-index layout issue.
issues.suggestion: Add proper margin to the badge or adjust the card container padding to ensure badges are contained within the visual boundaries.
